messages:
Priya: FYI - customer 'Foodly' reporting lots of 504s and timeouts on hosted inference since ~09:10 PT. They see p95 > 10s and many gateway 502/504s. Logs show 'request_queue_full' drops. Escalating now.
Mateo: looking. Any repro curl or tenant id?
Priya: tenant=foodly-prod, example request id=req_0a9f, sample curl attached. They mainly hit /v1/outputs chat endpoint with long seqs.
Priya: ```curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/outputs -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-***' -d '{"model":"openfast-70b","input":"<long prompt>"}'```
Alex: saw similar in morning on canary — continuous-batcher backlog spiked when many long-sequence requests queued. Could be kv-cache churn + queue-depth cap.
Jin: pinging infra metrics: ingress.queue_depth{service="hosted-gateway",tenant="foodly-prod"} jumped to 1200 at 09:11. Config cap is 1000, so we hit early-reject thresholds and then cascade retries.
ops-bot: autoscaler: dedicated-batcher-pool scaled from 10 -> 14 @ 09:12:06, cooldown 60s.
Mateo: are the 5xx from gateway or from downstream runtime? Sample log: `gateway: 504 downstream timeout waiting for dequeue after 30s`
Elena: I pulled gateway logs for req_0a9f: shows `enqueue_time=12.3s,dequeue_wait=18.9s,total=31.2s, error=deadline_exceeded`. So long tail in queue.
Priya: Customer is very unhappy, says it started after they increased concurrency and burst. They need immediate mitigation.
Alex: short-term mitigation options: 1) enforce tenant-level rate limit, 2) bump queue depth for hosted-gateway (risky), 3) prioritize small/interactive requests with routing policy, 4) scale batchers faster.
Mateo: quick check: any blocked/deadlocked batchers? `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=continuous-batcher` shows some pods OOM/killed?
Jin: pods are stable, no OOMs. But batcher backpressure metrics show long-lived batches: `batch_size_avg` went from 8 -> 34, `batch_hold_time` climbed to 220ms. That increases tail latency.
Mateo: that suggests many long-seq requests causing larger batch windows. We should enable small-request fast-path routing for interactive endpoints.
Priya: can we apply tenant throttle now so customer can at least get some requests through reliably?
Alex: applied token bucket limit on foodly-prod throttle=60rps at 09:20.
ops-bot: config-change: tenant-throttle(foodly-prod)=60rps applied by Alex @ 09:20:42
Priya: customer confirms errors dropping but still occasional 504s.
Elena: I added a temporary rule to prefer non-batched runtime for requests with `x-max-tokens < 512` to avoid batching long seqs with short ones. Rolling at 09:24.
Mateo: also adjusted queue reaper to early-drop requests older than 20s to avoid tail clog. Deployed 09:26.
Jin: monitoring: ingress.queue_depth -> 300 within 5m, p95 down to 1.6s by 09:33.
Priya: relaying to customer: "we applied temporary throttles and a fast-path; please let us know if you see new 5xxs."
Priya: customer requested repro steps to help their team: we asked them to share request distribution and example long prompts — they sent a batch of big prompts.
Alex: follow-up actions: - create runbook for tenant-flood causing continuous-batcher backlog - add alert when batch_hold_time > 150ms + queue_depth > 800 - investigate autoscaler aggressiveness for batchers - consider per-tenant batching isolation.
Mateo: I nailed down root cause: mix of many long-seq requests + bursts of retries from client when seeing early 502s. Feedback loop created queue saturation and larger batches -> higher latency -> more retries.
Elena: recording: `root_cause=tenant_flood + retry_staircase + batching_window_growth`
Priya: raising to CS for outreach and credits. Also asking product to consider a fast-path and safer default queue caps.
Jin: one thing to watch: increasing queue cap buys latency, not throughput. For long-term we should enforce better client-side retry guidance and backoff headers.
Alex: agreed. I'll open a ticket for per-tenant queue isolation and a doc for recommended retry/backoff values.
Priya: Customer satisfied with temporary fix and will test with our recommendations. Closing for now, will update if anything else pops. :thumbsup:
Mateo: leaving follow-up todo in #eng-oncall.
Elena: I added notes and timestamped traces to the incident board.
ops-bot: incident closed (temp fixes applied) @ 09:40:50
